dogecoin.text: I definitely don’t think dogecoin will be as successful as bitcoin. But who really knows...
Granted dogecoin is nothing but a hyped social media crypto, but don’t miss your beat lol. Take advantage of the easy money while you can.
I first invested in dogecoin March 2020 the week when everything first shut down. It’s was around 0.0012 if I recall. I told ppl to invest then, nobody listened to me lol.
